description: Finds local businesses in a city by keyword (name, category, service, product) and/or category. Returns contact details, hours availability and how many published prices each has.

category.description: Optional category or group keyword, e.g. "restaurant", "health_care"

query.description: What the user needs, e.g. "oil change", "pizza", "plumber", "haircut"

name: search_businesses
title: Search local businesses
